entities.name: Nine Titans
entities.description: A group of planeswalkers brought together by Urza to attack Phyrexia.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker who assembled the Nine Titans and built the titan engines.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The artificial plane the Titans attacked, which Urza spared from destruction.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: A planeswalker and member of the Nine Titans, killed by Tevesh Szat.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker first elected a Titan who instead phased himself and his lands out of the time stream.

entities.name: Parcher
entities.description: Planeswalker elected in the first draft but dropped by Urza as too crazy.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: Stepfather of Daria who demanded she join the Titans.

entities.name: Daria
entities.description: Taysir's stepdaughter and a member of the Titans, killed by Tevesh Szat.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Planeswalker who insisted Kristina come along.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: A Titan who betrayed the group and whose life energy fueled the soul bombs.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Ruler of Phyrexia to whom Urza surrendered himself.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane the Titans sought to protect.

entities.name: Titan engines
entities.description: Nine mechanized suits of powered armor built by Urza for the Titans.

events.summary: Urza gathers the Nine Titans to attack Phyrexia.
events.quote: The Nine Titans were a group of planeswalkers brought together by Urza to attack Phyrexia

events.summary: Teferi declines to join, so Urza accepts Daria in the group.
events.quote: Teferi changed his mind though and phased himself and his lands out of the time stream instead of joining.

events.summary: Freyalise insists Kristina join and Urza drops Parcher.
events.quote: Later Freyalise insisted that Kristina would come along, apparently just to spite Taysir, and Urza agreed

events.summary: Urza constructs the nine titan engines to survive Phyrexia.
events.quote: Urza constructed nine mechanized suits of powered armor called titan engines

events.summary: The Titans enter Phyrexia and begin destroying it.
events.quote: Entering Phyrexia, the Nine Titans began to destroy the artificial plane in a final gambit to protect Dominaria

events.summary: Tevesh Szat betrays the Titans and kills Daria and Kristina.
events.quote: Tevesh Szat betrayed the Titans and killed Daria and Kristina of the Woods.

events.summary: Urza reveals he predicted the betrayal and uses Szat's life energy to fuel the soul bombs.
events.quote: used Szat's life energy to fuel the soul bombs that would devastate Phyrexia

events.summary: Urza dismantles the master soul bomb instead of destroying Phyrexia, then surrenders to Yawgmoth.
events.quote: he dismantled the master soul bomb

relations.quote: Tevesh Szat betrayed the Titans and killed Daria and Kristina of the Woods.
